title: AnberTech: Kuafix, TurnuVolt, Grade Calculator and Formal Nöbet Çözücü
meta_desc: Apps by AnberTech: Kuafix, a hair salon and barber booking app; TurnuVolt, a tournament and fixture app; Grade Calculator, a grade and GPA app; and Formal Nöbet Çözücü, a free on-call schedule tool for doctors.
lead: AnberTech is an independent developer from Turkey. Each app does one job well: appointments, tournaments, grades and on-call rosters.
kfx_tag: Be the stylist, or the client
kfx_txt: Booking calendar, income tracking and statistics for hair salons; for customers: find a hairdresser, book online and try hairstyles with AI.
kfx_plat: iOS · Android · Turkish only · Premium subscription
tv_tag: Tournaments and leagues for any game
tv_txt: League and knockout fixtures, scores and standings for dozens of games, from football to table tennis, chess and esports. In 33 languages.
tv_plat: iOS · Android coming soon · One-time purchase
nh_txt: Calculate your course average, find the final exam grade you need to pass and track your GPA. No ads, no account, works offline. In 17 languages.
nf_txt: Builds a balanced monthly on-call schedule for hospital departments around overtime targets, leave and public holidays. Nothing to install.
about_p: AnberTech builds mobile apps and web tools that offer a simple solution to an everyday problem. The apps are published on the App Store and Google Play, and each has its own website with free web tools and guides. Kuafix and Formal Nöbet Çözücü are made in Turkish for Turkey; TurnuVolt and Grade Calculator are available in many languages.
faq: Grade Calculator and Formal Nöbet Çözücü are free. TurnuVolt is a one-time purchase. Kuafix is free to download and free for customers to book; the hairdresser panel needs a Premium subscription after a 1-month free trial.

Kuafix is for hair salon and barber appointments, TurnuVolt creates tournament and league fixtures for any game, Grade Calculator works out your average, the final grade you need and your GPA, and Formal Nöbet Çözücü builds monthly on-call rosters for doctors.
Can I try them without installing?
Yes. The TurnuVolt site has a free fixture generator, and the Grade Calculator site has free final grade, average and GPA calculators. Formal Nöbet Çözücü runs in the browser anyway.
TurnuVolt is available in 33 languages and Grade Calculator in 17. Kuafix and Formal Nöbet Çözücü are in Turkish.
How can I get in touch?
For general questions, write to destek.anbertech@gmail.com. Each app also has its own support page.
